scope: Native stroke layer for ink: canvas rendering, pointer pressure, OOXML ink part, draw/save/reload QA

implementation.rendering: Per-page <canvas class='op-word-ink'> 2D stroke layer replaces the SVG polyline overlay; redraw scheduled from a signal effect; canvas sized to devicePixelRatio
implementation.pressure: InkPoint gained pressure; pointer events with pointerType pen keep event.pressure (mouse defaults 0.5); stroke width = width * (0.35 + 0.65 * pressure) per segment
implementation.persistence: Strokes are stored in word/ink/ink1.xml (xmlns ink = http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/ink/2010/main), relationship type .../relationships/ink, content type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.ink+xml, anchored with w14:contentPart r:id='rIdInk' plus the _InkStrokes bookmark
implementation.compatibility: Legacy customXml/ink.xml is still read and saved in place; new documents use the OOXML ink part

checks: word ink OOXML part {part:441 bytes, rel:true, contentType:true}

runtimeQA.script: qa-ink.mjs on sample-real-proposal.docx (draw pen stroke with pressure, Ctrl+S, reload saved file)

remaining: The ink part is a dedicated OOXML part using the Microsoft ink namespace but not full InkML/Word ink markup; external Word may not render it
Spellcheck/grammar is rule/dictionary based, not a cloud language model like Microsoft Editor
VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
